objective: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moon well, release it, then bring it back to Winna.
Once you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.

description: This corrupted water can be used to our advantage, <name>. With just a small amount of the water, my kitten doubled in size, and seems to be stronger... somehow. These cats may prove useful...
Here, <name>. Take this cat carrier, and release the kitten inside next to the moonwell in the Ruins of Constellas. Heh, heh... I'm sure you'll be pleased with the results!
Return the cat to me, and I'm sure I can make it worth your time.
progress: Don't tell me that you can't go back there! Get going!
completion: The forsaken will resort to any means necessary to crush the alliance! The use of the corrupted water will surely prove useful in our future efforts...
